# telnyx_phone_number_verify_ownership (Action)

Checks which of the given phone numbers belong to the account and can be edited.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `phone_numbers` (List of String) Array of phone numbers to verify ownership for
